idea.title: Set up WhatsApp quick replies for listings
idea.angle: Say you get 20 messages a week asking the same things. Saved quick replies in WhatsApp Business let you answer basics in seconds and keep your time for real buyers.
idea.hook: STOP TYPING THE SAME REPLY 20 TIMES

slides.heading: STOP TYPING THE SAME REPLY **20 TIMES**
slides.body: Set it up once. Use it on every listing.

slides.heading: THE SAME QUESTIONS, **EVERY** WEEK
slides.body: Say you get 20 messages a week. Most ask the same things. Is it available? Where is it? Can I see it? You type each answer by hand.

slides.heading: SLOW REPLIES. **LATE** NIGHTS.
slides.body: You reply when you're free, so buyers wait. And you're still typing the same answers at night.

slides.heading: OPEN WHATSAPP **BUSINESS**
slides.body: Go to Settings, then Business tools. Tap Quick replies.

slides.heading: SAVE YOUR **TOP 3** ANSWERS
slides.body: Is it available, with the basics. How to book a viewing. Where it is. Give each one a short shortcut word.

slides.heading: TYPE A SLASH. **SEND** IN SECONDS.
slides.body: Type / in any chat and pick your reply. Add the listing name. Send.

slides.heading: LET QUICK REPLIES DO THE **BASICS**.
slides.body: Then add one personal line, so it never feels like a robot. Keep your time for real buyers.

slides.heading: SET IT UP **ONCE**
slides.body: Save this and set it up today

caption:
If you type the same reply again and again, you're losing time and buyers.

Say you get 20 messages a week asking the same things.
WhatsApp Business lets you save quick replies for the basics.
Type a slash, pick the reply, add the listing name, send.
You reply faster, and you don't work later.

Save this and set it up today.
